# Brief 02: Due diligence summary

Audience: investment committee of Kestrel Capital.
Decision: approve a binding bid for Marlow Components with a price ceiling of $240M.
Format: 10 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds the peer multiples used on slide 6.

## Facts

F1: Marlow revenue (USD million): 2023 118, 2024 131, 2025 142.
F2: Marlow adjusted EBITDA (USD million): 2023 21.2, 2024 25.1, 2025 29.6; the 2025 margin is 20.8%.
F3: Quality of earnings: reported 2025 EBITDA of $32.4M falls to $29.6M after removing $1.8M of capitalised R&D and a $1.0M one-off rebate release.
F4: Customer concentration: the largest customer is 31% of revenue, the top three 52% and the top ten 78%.
F5: Peer EV/EBITDA multiples: Aster 7.2x, Brandt 8.9x, Corvid 9.4x, Delmar 6.8x, Ember 8.1x, Fallow 7.6x; median 7.85x.
F6: The seller expects $270M, which is 9.1x adjusted 2025 EBITDA.
F7: Valuation ranges for Marlow (USD million): trading comparables 201 to 278, precedent transactions 222 to 252, discounted cash flow 215 to 255.
F8: Net debt is $41M and the pension deficit is $7M.
F9: Plant utilisation is 74%; replacing production line 2 needs $12M of capex over two years.
F10: Two patents covering 22% of revenue expire in 2028.
F11: One open environmental claim is estimated at $2.5M.
F12: Identified synergies reach $5.0M a year by year 3: procurement $3.1M and cross-sell $1.9M.
F13: Recommended price ceiling is $240M, which is 8.1x adjusted 2025 EBITDA.
